fnWorkflow.name: Render KaTeX Math
fnWorkflow.description: Reusable KaTeX burst render for question prompts. Loads KaTeX from CDN when head scripts are missing (editor preview).

RENDER_MATH.name: Burst render KaTeX
RENDER_MATH.__wwdescription: Load KaTeX if needed (editor preview) and typeset LaTeX in question text.

topicsUpdate.name: Load Topics Data
topicsUpdate.description: On Topics page load, wait for nested question repeaters then burst-render KaTeX (loads CDN in editor preview).

NOOP.name: Use app-loaded data
NOOP.__wwdescription: Topics data already loaded by app-level Load Student Data.

WAIT_FOR_REPEATERS.name: Wait for repeater data
WAIT_FOR_REPEATERS.__wwdescription: Give nested topic question repeaters time to render before KaTeX runs.

RENDER_MATH.name: Render KaTeX in question prompts
RENDER_MATH.__wwdescription: Load KaTeX if needed (editor preview) and typeset LaTeX in question text.

practiceUpdate.name: Render Practice KaTeX
practiceUpdate.description: On Practice page load, burst-render KaTeX for question prompt, model answer, and worked solution.

WAIT_FOR_UI.name: Wait for question card
WAIT_FOR_UI.__wwdescription: Give the practice question card time to render before KaTeX runs.

RENDER_MATH.name: Render KaTeX in practice prompts
RENDER_MATH.__wwdescription: Typeset LaTeX in practice question, model answer, and solution fields.

toggleUpdate.name: Toggle Topic Questions Expand
toggleUpdate.description: Toggle whether the current topic card shows all questions or only the first 3. After expanding, wait for new rows then render KaTeX.

TOGGLE_EXPAND.name: Toggle expanded topic questions
TOGGLE_EXPAND.__wwdescription: Expand this topic's full question list, or collapse back to 3 if already expanded.

IF_EXPANDED.name: Did we expand?
IF_EXPANDED.__wwdescription: Only re-render KaTeX when showing more questions, not when collapsing.

WAIT_EXPAND.name: Wait for expanded questions
WAIT_EXPAND.__wwdescription: Give the repeater time to render newly visible question rows.

RENDER_MATH.name: Render KaTeX after expand
RENDER_MATH.__wwdescription: Typeset LaTeX in newly visible question prompts.
